plot: The morning after the pumpkin mystery Max wants the shy squirrel Nutty as a friend before tonight's first snow, but chasing and offering fish only send her up the tree; Dog shows that squirrels come to whoever lies still like a boring log, Max can't stop pouncing at leaves, and when he finally lies still Nutty comes to sniff the pumpkin seeds still stuck in his fur, so Max shares them and they become friends just as the first snowflakes fall on her hidden seeds.

script.title: Can Max Make Friends With a Wild Squirrel?

beats.say: Wait! Come back, squirrel! I just want to be friends!
Eek! A big orange cat! Up the tree, up, up!
Max, every time you run, she runs even faster!
It's a cool autumn morning, the day after the pumpkin mystery.
Yesterday Max found out who bit Grandma's pumpkin lantern.
It was her! The squirrel with the giant fluffy tail!
Today I'll make her my friend. My very best friend!
Max, you still have pumpkin seeds stuck in your fur.
Seeds? No time, Grandma! I'm busy making friends!
Squirrels are shy, Max. You must be very gentle.
Gentle? I'm the gentlest cat in the whole garden!
Max tiptoes to the tree. Then he just can't wait.
Hello, squirrel! Want to play tag? Ready? You're it!
Nope! Nope! Too big! Too fast! Too orange!
Ha! She went right over the fence!
So Max tries a snack. Everybody loves fish, right?
Here, squirrel! Yummy fish! Come and get it!
Fish? Squirrels don't eat fish, silly cat! Yuck!
And with one flick of her tail, she's gone again.
Max, why are you waving a fish at a tree?
I'm making a friend, Bird. It's not going very well.
Squirrels like nuts and seeds. Everybody knows that!
She doesn't like me. Nobody fluffy ever likes me.
Don't be sad, Max. I know a squirrel secret.
You? But you chase squirrels every single day!
I used to. Now I'm smarter. Watch me.
Dog lies down in the leaves, as still as a log.
One minute later... tip, tap, tip, tap.
Hmm. A big brown log. A warm log. Nice log.
She walked right past his nose! How did he do that?
Squirrels come to you when you're boring, Max.
No running. No shouting. Just be a sleepy log.
And hurry, Max. Snow is coming tonight.
When it snows, squirrels hide away for days.
Tonight? Then today is my only chance!
Okay. Lesson one. Lie down. Tummy on the ground.
Lesson two. Don't look at the squirrel. Look at nothing.
Look at nothing? But everything is so interesting!
So Max lies down. Very still. Very, very boring.
I am a log. A quiet orange log. Nothing to see.
Then a yellow leaf floats right past his nose.
A leaf! A dancing leaf! I must catch it!
Eek! The log jumped! Logs don't jump!
Max... logs don't catch leaves.
Being boring is the hardest thing I've ever done!
Psst! Max! Try again! She's peeking from the branch!
Max lies down again. This time, he closes his eyes.
He thinks of quiet things. Clouds. Pillows. Grandma's slippers.
Boring, boring, boring. I am the most boring cat ever.
Sniff, sniff. What is that yummy smell?
Tip, tap. Closer. Tip, tap. Even closer.
Max! Don't move! Not one whisker!
Wait. She's sniffing my back. Why my back?
Pumpkin seeds! A whole cat covered in pumpkin seeds!
The seeds! Grandma said they were stuck in my fur!
So she never ran from you. She came for the snack!
Then I know just what a good friend would do.
Max picks the seeds out of his fur, one by one.
These are for you, little squirrel. You can have them all.
For me? A cat who shares? That's so... un-cat!
My name is Nutty. What's yours, kind log?
I'm Max! And, um, I'm not really a log.
I know. Logs don't purr when they're happy.
Well done, Max. Gentle and sharing. That's how friends begin.
And being boring! Don't forget the boring part!
Nutty stuffs her cheeks with seeds. Puff, puff, puff!
I'll hide some for winter. In my secret spot!
Where is your secret spot, Nutty?
If I tell you, it won't be a secret anymore!
Bye, Max! Thank you for the seeds! See you tomorrow!
Did you hear that, Dog? She said see you tomorrow!
Friends don't come when we chase.
They come when we are gentle, and when we share.
Then something small and cold lands on Max's nose.
Grandma! The sky is falling! In tiny white pieces!
The first snow! And Nutty's seeds are still out there...

long.title: Can Max Make Friends With a Wild Squirrel? 🐿️🐱
long.description:
"I only wanted a new friend. Why does she keep running away?" 🐱
Max wants the shy squirrel from the garden to be his friend, but every chase sends her up the tree. Dog has a funny secret: be as boring as a log! Max the Curious Cat, Ep 26.

#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation

de.title: Kann Max sich mit einem Eichhörnchen anfreunden? 🐿️🐱

„Ich wollte doch nur eine neue Freundin. Warum rennt sie immer weg?“ 🐱
Max möchte, dass das scheue Eichhörnchen im Garten seine Freundin wird, doch jede Jagd schickt es auf den Baum. Hund hat ein lustiges Geheimnis: so langweilig sein wie ein Baumstamm! Max die neugierige Katze, Folge 26.
#MaxTheCuriousCat #series #3DAnimation
